summary: output.json exists, matches the required schema exactly, and all three values are independently reproducible from features.csv / label.csv / corr_matrix.csv: 98 features -> 56 after |r|>0.8 greedy de-duplication (residual max |r| 0.798975), time split at 20231024 gives 34591/15319 rows with no date overlap, and an XGBoost refit reproduces train_auc 0.685984 / test_auc 0.632384 exactly. Only minor secondary-artifact inconsistencies (train_meta.json n_estimators, model_meta.json importance block) were found; they do not affect the deliverable.
